name: payment
title: Payment
description: Provider-agnostic payments for Lunora — Stripe-first checkout, metered usage tracking, entitlement checks, billing portal, and subscription queries built on @lunora/payment. Scaffolds the checkout / track / check / portal / subscriptions / webhook functions; the payment tables ship in the package as a schema extension. The provider adapter is wired into createShardDO (see docs).
docs: FIRST: merge the payment tables into your lunora/schema.ts with one line — import { paymentExtension } from "@lunora/payment" and append .extend(paymentExtension) to your defineSchema({ ... }) call. The tables are namespaced payment_* and ship with the package, so upgrading @lunora/payment brings new columns and indexes with no schema edit. Skip this step and the first ctx.payments.* call fails with UNKNOWN_TABLE. THEN wire the adapter into your Worker entry's createShardDO({ payment: (env) => ({ adapter: createStripeAdapter({ client: new Stripe(env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, { httpClient: Stripe.createFetchHttpClient() }), webhookSecret: env.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET }), entitlements: { plans: { pro: { features: ['export'], limits: { api_calls: 1000 }, priceIds: ['price_xxx'] } } } }) }) — createStripeAdapter takes a single options object, and the thunk receives `env` only (no `ctx`), so leave `authorize` out unless you are replacing the default "caller owns the referenceId" rule. Then add the POST /payment/webhook HTTP route (see the generated file header for the snippet), run `lunora codegen`, and set APP_BASE_URL, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET in .dev.vars. APP_BASE_URL is also declared in wrangler.jsonc `vars` so it reaches the generated env type — see README §4 for that and its tsconfig prerequisite (wrangler secret put for the two secrets in production).

envVars.name: APP_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Public origin of this deployment (e.g. https://app.example.com). Used to build the checkout success/cancel and billing-portal return URLs — a Lunora context carries no Request to derive an origin from. Scaffolded EMPTY: set it to the origin your app is served on — locally that is your dev server's URL (e.g. http://localhost:5173 under Vite).

envVars.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
envVars.description: Stripe secret key (test mode: sk_test_...). Obtain from the Stripe dashboard.

envVars.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
envVars.description: Stripe webhook signing secret (whsec_...). Set in the Stripe dashboard for your /payment/webhook endpoint.
